run_verify_episodes: run the verify_episodes script to validate all episodes in a Habitat collaboration dataset
run_run_eval: run the run_eval function to evaluate episodes using Hydra config with single or multi-process verification
run_run_verifier: run the run_verifier function to iterate over dataset episodes and record success or failure metrics
compute_compute_stats: compute aggregate statistics from episode check JSON files and write a summary JSON report
refactor_run_eval: refactor the run_eval function to support chunking episodes by scene instead of by index
